title: Woodcraft
author: George Washington Sears

authorInfo.bio: George Washington Sears (1821–1890) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Woodcraft" by George Washington Sears is a practical guide on outdoor skills and camping, likely written in the late 19th century. The text discusses various techniques and tips for enjoying nature to its fullest, emphasizing the importance of proper preparation and equipment for outdoor activities such as fishing and camping.
